lead: A menu bar: a row of top-level menus. Once one is open, moving the pointer to a neighbour switches to it directly, and the Left / Right arrow keys move between them. The popups and items reuse Menu's theme style.

api.title: API Reference
api.description: `Menubar` is the `role=menubar` row, `Menubar.Menu` the root of each top-level menu and `Menubar.Trigger` its button. `Content` / `Item` / `CheckboxItem` / `Group` / `GroupLabel` / `Separator` are the parts of the same name from [Menu](/menu).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles style the bar and its triggers in `menubar.css`; the popups and items come from `menu.css`. As for every overlay, `data-skein-theme` must be set on `<html>`.
styling.menubar: The bar and its top-level triggers; the open one has `data-popup-open`
styling.menu-positioner: The popup and its items, reusing Menu's slots
